reviews.title: Glitches
reviews.text: I had high hopes for this app, but it’s been pretty frustrating. It often glitches out—sometimes it freezes, and other times it just shuts down entirely. I’ve had to restart it multiple times in one session. It’s a shame because the features seem promising, but the reliability just isn’t there yet.

reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: They don’t offer a trial and you won’t get a refund. This app suckered me into a promise of value, but severely under-delivered. It’s like many apps that believe everything is one-size-fits-all but doesn’t consider different lifestyles, access to equipment, specific goals are different in detail from one person to another. You’re better off choosing an app that lets you try it before you buy it. This one will tempt you with slashing the price, which suckered me, but at the end of the day, if I’m not going to use it, I shouldn’t have paid anything.
